verdict.rationale: Hummingbird's marketing says it automates alert dispositioning, moves cases between AI agents and the human team, and "keeps every decision defensible." An automatic audit trail of all work is also documented, which suggests the original automated work and rationale are preserved when a human takes over. No documentation shows a specific flow for inspecting an automated decision's evidence and rationale and then overriding it. Missing for 10: a documented override/reversal of automated dispositions, explicit preservation of the original AI evidence and rationale alongside the override, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
